creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, Chat Notes 2026-10-13: "right click mark as unread". Clarified 2026-10-16: agent rows only, for now.

The use is marking an email unread: you glance at an agent that finished and want it to keep asking until you come back. Today whether a pane has been seen is computed, never set: a pane focused and on screen is seen, and a finish there is not announced (`docs/architecture.md`, attention routing). Marking a row unread would put the pane back to `done` and into what `focus_asking` (⌘⇧A) walks, without raising a banner.

To decide:

- The architecture says seen-ness "decides what a pane is and is not a person's to configure". This makes it a person's, for one gesture, so that line needs revisiting rather than routing around.
- What clears it. The row you right-click is often the focused pane, so "the next time it is seen" would clear it at once. The next focus after focus has left it is likelier.
- A CLI verb beside the menu item, since every action has one.
title: Mark an agent row unread from its right-click menu
